nodes.label: launchPersistentContext switch
nodes.rationale: Persistent context fixes the '(Incognito Window)' flag: real storage quota ~297 GB vs ephemeral ~1.3 GB.

nodes.label: Stealth addInitScript patch chain
nodes.rationale: Init scripts override navigator.userAgentData, outerHeight/availHeight/storage.persist, readPixels on 256x24 canvas, and MessageEvent.prototype.data to align spoofed fingerprint signals with headless Chromium.

nodes.label: Proxy health-aware rotation (markBanned / markSuccess)
nodes.rationale: Disables a proxy for 30 min after 3 failures; success resets fail count.

nodes.label: parseSafely graceful parse error handling
nodes.rationale: Parse errors are stored as {parseError:true} with status failed instead of retrying, since retries would not fix a selector mismatch.

nodes.label: pixelscan jsModifyDetected root cause (top.MD5 missing)
nodes.rationale: fptc canvasHash/webglHash throw because pixelscan's MD5 module is not exposed on window, so frameFpCollect lacks keys and mismatches selfFpCollect; proposed fix is injecting window.MD5 via addInitScript.
